title: loc 与 iloc 的端点差异，以及 CoW 下的副本语义
expected_output:
s =
a    10
b    20
c    30
d    40
e    50
dtype: int64
loc['b':'d']  = {'b': 20, 'c': 30, 'd': 40} -> 按标签，闭区间
iloc[1:4]     = {'b': 20, 'c': 30, 'd': 40} -> 按下标，左闭右开
--- DataFrame 上同样成立 ---
   v
x  1
y  2
z  3
loc['x':'y'] =
   v
x  1
y  2
iloc[0:2] =
   v
x  1
y  2
--- 布尔筛选得到的是副本（CoW 下改它不影响原表）---
sub =
   v
y  2
z  3
改 sub 之后原 df :
   v
x  1
y  2
z  3
pandas 3.x 默认 Copy-on-Write : True
code:
import pandas as pd
s = pd.Series([10, 20, 30, 40, 50], index=list("abcde"))
print("s =")
print(s)
print("loc['b':'d']  =", s.loc["b":"d"].to_dict(), "-> 按标签，闭区间")
print("iloc[1:4]     =", s.iloc[1:4].to_dict(), "-> 按下标，左闭右开")
print("--- DataFrame 上同样成立 ---")
df = pd.DataFrame({"v": [1, 2, 3]}, index=["x", "y", "z"])
print(df)
print("loc['x':'y'] =")
print(df.loc["x":"y"])
print("iloc[0:2] =")
print(df.iloc[0:2])
print("--- 布尔筛选得到的是副本（CoW 下改它不影响原表）---")
sub = df[df["v"] > 1]
print("sub =")
print(sub)
sub["v"] = 0
print("改 sub 之后原 df :")
print(df)
print("pandas 3.x 默认 Copy-on-Write :", pd.options.mode.copy_on_write)
